Updates to PSC Code

Sources Sought Notice:  SPRDL1-25-R-0220

Small Business Set-Aside

ITEM NAME: MANUAL DRIVE ASSEMBLY

NSN:  1015-01-694-6779

Part Number: 12590868

QTY: 168 

OPTION QTY: 168

FOB:  Destination

END ITEM:  JE – ABRAMS Tank

Interested sources shall indicate they are capable of providing the required item listed above and must provide:

1. Full name and address of the firm

2. Unique Entity ID and CAGE Code

3. Point of Contact

4. Size Status (i.e., Small Business, 8(a), HUBZone, Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), Small Disadvantage Business, Women- Owned Small Business)

5. Capability Statement

Questions regarding this announcement shall be submitted in writing by e-mail to the Contracting Specialist listed as the Point of Contact on this notice. Questions will be answered by posting answers to this announcement. Questions shall not contain proprietary or classified information. The Government does not guarantee that questions received after August 20, 2025 will be answered. THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) ONLY to identify sources that can provide the items listed above. The information provided in the RFI is subject to change and is not binding on the Government. The Defense Logistics Agency - Land, Warren, has not made a commitment to procure any of the items discussed, and release of this RFI should not be construed as such a commitment or as authorization to incur costs for which reimbursement would be required or sought
